Plan review: Add `clamp(v, lo, hi)` to calc.js · ~/.commandcode/plans/add-clamp-to-calc.md · v1
Review the plan like a PR — type on any line to comment, enter pins it under the line.

   1   # Add `clamp(v, lo, hi)` to calc.js
   2
   3   ## Goal
   4   Export a `clamp` helper that constrains `v` to the inclusive range `[lo, hi]`.
   5
   6   ## Change
   7   Edit `calc.js` only — append after `mul` (lines 5-7), matching the existing
   8   ES-module named-export style with no added dependencies:
   9
  10   ```js
  11   export function clamp(v, lo, hi) {
  12     return Math.min(Math.max(v, lo), hi);
  13   }
  14   ```
  15
  16   ## Behavior
  17   - `clamp(5, 0, 10)` → `5`; `clamp(-1, 0, 10)` → `0`; `clamp(11, 0, 10)` → `10`.
  18   - If `lo > hi`, result is `lo` (documented, not an error) — matches
       `Math.min/max` semantics.
  19   - `NaN`/non-numeric inputs propagate `NaN`; no validation or coercion added.
  20
  21   ## Verification
  22   `node --input-type=module -e "import('./calc.js').then(m =>
       console.log(m.clamp(11,0,10)))"` → prints `10`.
  23   Optional: add these three cases as a small test file if a runner is later
       introduced.
  24
